question:
Direction: Study the following arrangement carefully and answer the given question.

A 3 P K I ¥ B $ Q 8 1 P A @ R O M N B 7 S G L A & T B # U R H C A 9 V

If all the odd numbers and vowels are removed, then what will be the element 8th from the right end?
solution:
The logic follows here is:

**Given series:** A 3 P K I ¥ B $ Q 8 1 P A @ R O M N B 7 S G L A & T B # U R H C A 9 V

Conditions to be checked

1. If all the odd numbers and vowels are removed

New series will be formed is as follows:

**New series:** P K ¥ B $ Q 8 P @ R M N B S G L & T B # R H C V

The element 8th from the right end is **&**.

P K ¥ B $ Q 8 P @ R M N B S G L __**&**__ T B # R H C V

Hence, the correct answer is **&**.
